be.sense: identity or permanent quality (she is tall)
temporary state or location (she is tired)

have.sense: possess or own (I have a car)
auxiliary or existential use (there has been)

get.sense: fetch or pick up (get the kids)

know.sense: be aware of a fact (know the answer)
be familiar with a person or place (know her)

take.sense: grab or pick up (take the book)
consume or accept (take a pill, take a bath)

use.sense: make use of, more formal (utilize a resource)

tell.sense: say to someone (tell me the time)

work.sense: do a job (work at a bank)

leave.sense: go out of a place (leave the house)
put down or abandon (leave it there)

call.sense: summon or name (call a taxi, call him John)

become.sense: turn or get to be (become sad)

put.sense: place, with the variant preference swapped

keep.sense: maintain or continue to have (keep calm)
store or hold on to (keep the receipt)

show.sense: demonstrate or prove (show that it works)

run.sense: move fast on foot (run a mile)

move.sense: relocate to live elsewhere (move to Lisbon)

live.sense: be alive or lead a life (live a long life)

believe.sense: trust or have faith in (believe in you)

meet.sense: meet someone for the first time (meet her)
encounter or get together (meet at noon)

change.sense: become or make different (change my mind)

watch.sense: view a show or match (watch TV)

follow.sense: accompany or keep up with (follow the news)

walk.sense: stroll or hike (walk by the sea)
go for a walk (walk the dog)

win.sense: be victorious or earn (win a prize)

remember.sense: bring to mind, reflexive form in both variants
recall the past (remember the old days)

wait.sense: await, more formal (wait for a reply)

die.sense: pass away, formal (he died last year)

decide.sense: make up one's mind (decide to go)

support.sense: hold up or provide for (support a family)

listen.sense: pay attention to sound (listen to music)
hear or listen to (hear a song)

apply.sense: apply for a job or place (apply to a university)

fail.sense: not pass an exam (fail a class)

enjoy.sense: make good use of the moment (enjoy the day)

save.sense: rescue or store data (save a file)

drop.sense: let fall by accident (drop a glass)

finish.sense: end or run out (finish the milk)

act.sense: perform a role or function (act as manager)

connect.sense: link or switch on (connect the lamp)

deal.sense: treat or address a topic (deal with an issue)

introduce.sense: bring in something new (introduce a rule)

operate.sense: perform surgery or run machinery (operate on a patient)

order.sense: request food or a drink (order a pizza)

persuade.sense: urge to do something (persuade me to go)

press.sense: push with force or pressure (press the issue)
squeeze or push a button (press the button)

repair.sense: restore to working order (repair a machine)

shake.sense: move back and forth (shake the bottle)
